The fill-in CLI end to end on scratch copies passes 13/13. 63 mutants were run, all killed, every restore sha-verified.

Four design constraints, all measured in existing nodes, forced deviations from the literal rulings:
(1) The new answer keys cannot be top-level in the fill-in data file. The frozen _fill_in_schema_problems in test_legal_docs_u8.py rejects unknown keys, which would redden T7a/T11. The existing B1 nodes fill a missing top-level key from _SAMPLE_ANSWERS, which raises KeyError. The keys therefore live under "placeholders" as strings: CONTROLLER_COUNTRY, RETENTION_CLEANUP_LIVE ("true"|"false"), REFERRAL_PUSH_DISPLAY_NAME_ONLY ("true"|"false"), DPO_CONTACT_DETAILS(_AR). Null is their documented default and is never reported missing.
(2) The fixed-period refusal treats a value as a fixed period when it has a digit or a duration word. The literal rule ("anything but no-fixed-period wording") would refuse the synthetic values the existing B1 nodes write.
(3) CLOUDFLARE_CLAUSE is a fork (cloudflare_clause) with the line inline and an empty false variant. T7a needs "Cloudflare" in the committed policy.
(4) The F5 wording keeps test_fix_a2's EN marker and adds the search-engine image server.

questions_for_orchestrator: Q1 (UP4 A11/A12/A15 key placement): the rulings name top-level answer keys (controller_country, dpo_contact + _AR, retention_cleanup_live, referral_push_display_name_only). Two measured blockers prevent that. First, the frozen _fill_in_schema_problems in tests/test_legal_docs_u8.py rejects unknown top-level keys, so T7a/T11 would turn red. Second, the existing B1 nodes' _filled_copy fills a missing top-level key from _SAMPLE_ANSWERS[key] and would raise KeyError. The keys therefore live under 'placeholders' as strings: CONTROLLER_COUNTRY, RETENTION_CLEANUP_LIVE ('true'|'false'), REFERRAL_PUSH_DISPLAY_NAME_ONLY ('true'|'false'), DPO_CONTACT_DETAILS(_AR). Null is their documented default and they are never reported missing, so neither T2 nor the script forces them at the fill-in; the UP6 checklist in PR_NOTES_POLISH.md must. Accept, or move them top-level in a later unit that is allowed to amend the test schema and _SAMPLE_ANSWERS?

Q2 (A11 rule): a value counts as a fixed period if it has a digit or a duration word (EN and AR). The literal 'anything but no-fixed-period wording' would refuse the synthetic 'security_log_retention sample value' that the existing B1 nodes write. Edge cases follow from this: 'a fortnight' passes, and AR 'عام' meaning 'general' is refused. Accept?
